roleLabel: Back-line dual-DoT Mage — channels Burn + Frost beam that rewards Stall and uptime
bestFor: Stall / Mage boards that can keep her channeling while enemies stay in the beam
strength: Requiem Barrage applies Frost and Burn every tick; Stall paths permanently grow Magic and beam duration
weakness: Channel can be wasted if she dies, gets interrupted, or packs leave the beam — positioning is everything

howToPlay.early: Protect the backline first. She is a carry, not an opener. Mana/Magic come after a tank exists.
howToPlay.mid: Crescendo = Stall permanent Magic and longer beams. Resplendent = team Mage Debuff amp. Harmony = beam also Shields allies. Pick Stall snowball, tribal Debuffs, or peel support.
howToPlay.late: Stack Stall and Magic. Keep her alive for full channels — a cancelled beam is a lost fight plan.
howToPlay.positioning: Back row aimed down the main lane so the beam covers where packs actually stand. Re-aim after losses; do not assume the default angle is correct.

abilityNotes.Requiem Barrage: Full channel value requires enemies inside the beam for the whole duration. Fix geometry before buying another Magic relic.

specNotes.The Crescendo: Default Stall carry — permanent Magic and longer Barrage after Stall thresholds.
specNotes.The Resplendent: Team Mage Debuff path. Take with multiple Mages applying status.
specNotes.The Harmony: Supportive beam that Shields allies. Take when the board needs peel as much as DoT.

relicReasons.mages-elemental-banner-595: Burn/Frost elemental identity for the dual-DoT beam.
relicReasons.mages-cataclysm-engine-4006: AoE Mage engine that matches Barrage’s zone damage.
relicReasons.mages-administration-filigree-3014: Caster admin tools for repeated channels.

faq.question: Is Aria good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Top-tier Mage carry when protected and aimed well. Feels terrible if she channels into empty space or dies mid-beam. Buy with a tank plan.

faq.question: What class is Aria?
faq.answer: Mage. Role focus: back-line dual Burn/Frost channel carry.

faq.question: What relics work with Aria?
faq.answer: Mage Elemental/Cataclysm pieces, Stall enablers for Crescendo, and Arcane amplifiers.

faq.question: How do you play Aria?
faq.answer: Tank for her, aim Requiem Barrage down the pack path, stack Stall/Magic, and pick Crescendo for snowball or Harmony if you need Shields from the beam.

tips: After every loss, ask: did the beam hit? If not, move her or the tank before rerolling relics.
Crescendo without Stall is half-powered — add Stall or switch branch.
